mathematics.assertion_tested: For every scalar-record family-explorer link generated from the 2,292-record catalogue, the current exact JavaScript engine accepts its emitted parameters and reproduces every stored integer, original rational value where recorded, local offset and source degree in the complete requested prefix, truncated only to the available stored window. Every compared prefix contains at least eight terms; no sampling of links is used.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and reduced rational numbers; no floating tolerance
mathematics.conventions: Decimal strings cross JSON; original local offsets and source-degree maps are compared. Appell columns use polynomial row N*n+k and ordinary [x^k] coefficients. Factorial normalizations belong to the stated source degree. Rational denominators are positive.
inputs: The 2,292 preserved integer records and every generated family-explorer link.
Independent Python catalogue coefficients and source coordinates versus the actual JavaScript family engine.

bounds.sampling: none; every emitted link is visited

non_claims: No claim about coefficients beyond the compared stored prefixes.
No infinite-sequence identity or historical novelty follows from finite agreement.
Definition-only links and analytic families are counted but not numerically evaluated.
Browser layout, events, clipboard and download behavior require separate browser tests.
The Python catalogue is the preserved comparison oracle; this audit does not independently prove every catalogue formula.
